correctness.rationale: With alternating opposite pinned boundary opinions, each open voter interval has an odd nonincreasing number of discordant edges; every multi-wall class can eliminate a pair of walls with positive probability, leaving its sole recurrent reflecting-wall chain. The latter has uniform edge position and disjoint intervals evolve independently. Thus X_g=r+sum_i U_{g_i} with E=n/2 and Var=sum_i(g_i²-1)/12. The exact discrete-trapezoid PMF difference under (a,b)->(a+1,b-1), b>=a+2, changes sign from positive tails to negative interior and has mass and first moment zero; affine-secant convexity proves strict all-test improvement. Integral majorization gives unique gap-multiset extrema. Independent rational uniform convolution gave variance 8/3 for (3,3,3,3) versus 20/3 for (9,1,1,1). n=m, m=2 and gaps one are included.
